597d8629: **********************************************************************
   THIS ROUTINE IMPLEMENTS THE ENVIRONMENT CHECK PROTOCOL FOR THE 
                   INCOMPLETE RECORDS TRACKING PACKAGE.

   EACH STEP OF THE PROTOCOL IS DOCUMENTED BELOW.
**********************************************************************

fb6e5abf: **********************************************************************
   ENTRY POINT FOR THE CHECK PROTOCOL. ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES ARE
   VALIDATED AND IF SUCCESSFUL, THE PROTOCOL BEGINS.
**********************************************************************
07ce4558: RESET THE XPDABORT VARIABLE TO AN EMPTY STRING.
b2b0b469: VALIDATE THAT THE USER IS A PROGRAMMER, CURRENT DATE IS SET AND THE $U VARIABLE IS EQUAL TO '^'. IF ANY OF THESE CONDITIONS ARE FALSE, THE INSTALLATION IS ABORTED.
b5b0644f: DISPLAY AN ERROR MESSAGE INDICATING THAT THE PROGRAMMING VARIABLES ARE NOT SETUP PROPERLY.
615cc472: DISPLAY A MESSAGE INDICATING THAT THE INSTALLATION IS BEING ABORTED.
43f63377: DISPLAY A MESSAGE INDICATING THAT THE INSTALLATION IS BEING ABORTED.
991ffe26: VALIDATE THAT THE INSTALLED VERSION OF THE INCOMPLETE RECORDS TRACKING PACKAGE IS 1.0. IF NOT, THE INSTALLATION IS ABORTED.
5b3081b4: DISPLAY AN ERROR MESSAGE INDICATING THAT VERSION 1.0 OF THE INCOMPLETE RECORDS TRACKING PACKAGE HAS NOT BEEN LOADED.
8f464e49: DISPLAY A MESSAGE INDICATING THAT THE INSTALLATION HAS BEEN ABORTED.
92620250: DISPLAY A MESSAGE INDICATING THAT THE INSTALLATION HAS BEEN ABORTED.
1f5dcaf2: DISPLAY A MESSAGE INDICATING THAT THE ENVIRONMENT CHECK WAS SUCCESSFUL.
9d30248c: NORMAL EXIT POINT FOR THE ENVIRONMENT CHECK PROTOCOL.

c58fbf4e: **********************************************************************
   ENTRY POINT TO EXIT THE INSTALLATION AND SET AN XPDABORT FLAG
   INDICATING THAT THE INSTALLATION WAS NOT SUCCESSFUL.
**********************************************************************
0a10cdea: SET THE XPDABORT VARIABLE TO 2 TO INDICATE AN UNSUCCESSFUL INSTALLATION.
